institution: Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras)
degree_program: BS in Data Science and Applications

pillars.name: Linear Algebra & Matrix Geometry
pillars.description: Vector spaces, subspaces, orthogonal projections, least squares, spectral theorem, SVD, and PCA.

pillars.name: Multivariable Calculus
pillars.description: Gradients, directional derivatives, Jacobians, Hessians, and multidimensional Taylor expansions.

pillars.name: Optimization & Duality
pillars.description: Unconstrained gradient descent, learning rates, Lagrange multipliers, convexity, KKT conditions, and SVMs.

pillars.name: Probability & Statistical Models
pillars.description: Axioms of probability, Bayes' rule, random variables, multivariate normal distributions, and GMM/EM.

modules.title: Introduction to Machine Learning, Tasks & Taxonomy
modules.description: Introduction to Machine Learning, taxonomy (supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement), data representation, vectors, inner products, and basic linear algebra setup.

modules.title: Calculus for ML: Sets, Functions & Derivatives
modules.description: Multivariable calculus foundations: sets, limits, directional derivatives, the gradient vector, Jacobians, Hessian curvature matrices, and Taylor approximations.

modules.title: Linear Algebra: Subspaces, Orthogonality & Least Squares
modules.description: The four fundamental subspaces, orthogonal complements, projection matrices, the orthogonality principle, normal equations, and least squares linear regression.

modules.title: Regression, Eigenvalues & Matrix Diagonalization
modules.description: Linear and polynomial regression extensions, eigenvalues, eigenvectors, characteristic polynomials, algebraic vs geometric multiplicity, and matrix diagonalization.

modules.title: Complex Matrices, Hermitian Matrices & Spectral Theory
modules.description: Complex matrices, Hermitian and real symmetric matrices, the Spectral Theorem, quadratic forms, positive definiteness, and the Rayleigh quotient.

modules.title: Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) & Positive Definiteness
modules.description: Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), geometric action on unit spheres, low-rank matrix approximation (Eckart-Young-Mirsky Theorem), and positive definite matrices.

modules.title: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) & Dimensionality Reduction
modules.description: Dimensionality reduction, sample covariance matrices, Principal Component Analysis (PCA) as maximum variance and minimum reconstruction error, and scree plots.

modules.title: Unconstrained Optimization, Taylor Series & Gradient Descent
modules.description: Unconstrained optimization, descent directions, learning rate selection, condition numbers, Lipschitz smoothness, and batch gradient descent convergence.

modules.title: Constrained Optimization, Lagrange Multipliers & Convexity
modules.description: Constrained optimization, Lagrange multipliers, convex sets, convex functions, projection operators, and projected gradient descent.

modules.title: Duality, KKT Conditions & Optimization in ML
modules.description: Lagrangian duality, primal and dual problems, weak and strong duality, Slater condition, Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) optimality, and Support Vector Machines.

modules.title: Probability Foundations: Discrete & Continuous Distributions
modules.description: Probability spaces, Kolmogorov axioms, conditional probability, Bayes' theorem, discrete and continuous random variables, expectations, and key distributions.

modules.title: Multivariate Gaussians, GMMs, EM Algorithm & Limit Theorems
modules.description: Multivariate Gaussian distributions, covariance geometry, Gaussian Mixture Models (GMM), the Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm, and concentration inequalities.
